property_summary: For any caller other than the deployer-owner, NETM() must revert and leave every token balance untouched; the mutant inverts onlyOwner so a non-owner's NETM() succeeds and mints totalDistributed to the caller, violating the rule.
change_summary: Invert the onlyOwner check so non-owners can invoke NETM(), letting a non-owner caller set balances under a new owner.
